prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1018; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A dated inspection photo shows the same dent before this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officer narrative, Baytown, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane when Driver 2 changed lanes and sideswiped the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee at the scene and said the knee struck the lower dash during the impact. The injury is consistent with the direction and force of the collision as I observed the damage. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle runs along the left rear quarter panel and matches the described contact. Scene photographs confirm the general positions of both vehicles, but no independent witnesses came forward. Driver 1 and the Passenger both confirmed that Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel at the time. Among the photos submitted for the claim, one from an earlier inspection shows a dent in the same location on the left rear quarter panel. Driver 2 is listed as a named driver on the policy under which the claim was filed. No citations were issued at the scene. The report is referred for further review.
